note: Re-judged 2026-10-31: TestRFC7440FieldsAreNULTerminatedASCIIStrings now requests blksize, tsize and windowsize 16 and requires the OACK to be exactly six non-empty printable-ASCII fields each ending in one NUL (blksize 1024, tsize 700, windowsize 16): a missing or doubled NUL, a non-ASCII octet, or an extra or missing field is red. Its request half is unchanged: the Section 3 example parses into foobar, octet, windowsize; an unterminated #blocks leaves windowsize unrecognised (parseRRQ breaks on valEnd < 0); a filename with no NUL is refused. TestTFTPParseRRQ/Invalid changed only in claim comments. Client TestRFC7440ClientRequestFieldsAreNULTerminatedASCII unchanged.
